title: Projected Grouped-Query Attention in PyTorch
prompt:
Implement `GQA(n_heads, dim, n_kv_heads)` with `forward(x, mask=None) -> output` of shape `(B, T, dim)`. Set `head_dim = dim // n_heads` and `kv_dim = n_kv_heads * head_dim`. `W_qkv` maps dim to `dim + 2 * kv_dim`, ordered as all Q features, then all K features, then all V features. `W_o` maps dim to dim. Query head h uses KV head `h // (n_heads // n_kv_heads)`; groups must be contiguous, not alternating. Scores have shape `(B, n_heads, T, T)`. Support equal Q/KV head counts (MHA), intermediate counts (GQA), and one KV head (MQA). Also reject n_heads not divisible by n_kv_heads with AssertionError.

Use PyTorch on CPU. Preserve the public API and expose biased `nn.Linear` layers named `W_qkv` and `W_o`. Inputs are floating tensors `x: (B, T, dim)` with positive dimensions. Preserve dtype/device and autograd; do not mutate inputs or parameters. No dropout, residual connection, layer normalization, positional encoding, or implicit causal mask is required. `mask` is either None or a boolean tensor broadcastable to attention scores; True means allowed. Every query row has at least one allowed key. Apply the mask before softmax over keys, and scale scores by `1 / sqrt(head_dim)`. Reject nonpositive or nondivisible constructor head/dimension values with AssertionError. Input shapes, mask dtype, and mask rows otherwise satisfy this contract.

example.reasoning: Query heads 0 and 1 share KV head 0, while query heads 2 and 3 share KV head 1. Projection widths are 8 for Q and 4 each for K and V.
